summary: Martinac was endorsed by CAIR Action and rated an Ally by Vote for Peace in the general election, both organizations that evaluate candidates on Gaza and ceasefire positions. CAIR-SFBA's tracker recorded her support for a ceasefire resolution by December 2023, a tracker listing rather than a verified roll-call transcript. As a Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board commissioner, these endorsements and the local ceasefire action form her documented record on Palestinian justice.
